data.content: Implementation complete. Branch worktree-knots-edf8-machine-id-atomic @ dc73d66916f2, rebased onto f3244ad8 and pushed. First-use persistence is now atomic: unique temp file + hard_link as the atomic create-if-absent, converging on the winner's value on AlreadyExists so every racer returns the id that actually landed on disk. machine_id() returns io::Result<String> so a persist failure surfaces instead of being swallowed; all call sites propagate, including src/sync/mod.rs which knots-0f9c added after this branch was cut. Verified: make sanity exit 0 (1294 tests, 95.24% coverage); the owner-guard and cache-lock regression tests still pass; knots-4bfa's PATH fix preserved through the rebase (no set_var("PATH") under src/).
